method: Written from model knowledge plus targeted web checks on 2026-10-03 (no simulated nominations). Achievement-centred longlist for a merge with an independent GPT draft. 'nominees' is a provisional award of at most three parties (individuals and/or organisations); 'other_names' holds associated people, alternative framings or co-credited bodies for the merge stage to weigh. Order is thematic, not a ranking. Publicly known 2026 nominations (Wikipedia, '2026 Nobel Peace Prize') and the PRIO Director's 2026 list (prio.org/news/3693, updated at prio.org/news/3746) are all included and flagged in 'note'. Bookmaker positions as of late Sept 2026 (oddschecker, covers.com) are noted only for the leading entries. The nomination count is 287 (208 individuals, 79 organisations); the full list is sealed for 50 years. Excludes laureates and achievements already honoured 2005-2025 as primary awards (e.g. Machado 2025, Nihon Hidankyo 2024, Mohammadi 2023, Bialiatski/Memorial/CCL 2022, Ressa/Muratov 2021, WFP 2020, Mukwege/Murad 2018, ICAN 2017); earlier laureates (MSF, ICRC, UNHCR, IAEA, Amnesty) appear only where a repeat is plausible and are flagged. Committee-proximity check against agent-data/peace/committee/ROSTER.md: CARE International is excluded (Gry Larsen was Secretary General of CARE Norway 2015-2020), and PEN International/Norwegian PEN are excluded (chair Jørgen Watne Frydnes was Secretary General of PEN Norway). PRIO is a nominator, not a candidate. Committee secretary Harpviken is the former PRIO director. Living status for 115 named individuals was checked via a Wikidata SPARQL query on 2026-10-03; none were found deceased (homonyms resolved by hand). Wikidata gave no match for Abid Shamdeen, Alaa Abd el-Fattah, Alokiir Malual, Benetick Kabua Maddison, Davi Kopenawa, Fadel Abdul Ghany, Grace Forrest, Hadi Al Khatib, José Daniel Ferrer, Maria Kalesnikava, Óscar Camps, Raed Al Saleh, Sepideh Gholian, Siosiua Veikune, Venâncio Mondlane, Vishal Prasad and Wael Al-Dahdouh; they are assumed living. Events after the model's June 2026 knowledge cutoff were checked only in outline (Gaza ceasefire holding, Sudan Quad talks, Ukraine talks stalled).
